name: Radicale
description: Calendars and contacts for your mailboxes. Sync native CalDAV and CardDAV clients using your existing IMAP account, with data stored on your chosen server.

services.name: radicale
commandArgv: exec /app/bin/python /app/bin/radicale --config '' --server-hosts 0.0.0.0:5232 --auth-type imap --auth-imap-host="${IMAP_HOST:?Set the IMAP hostname}:993" --auth-imap-security tls --auth-lc-username --auth-urldecode-username --no-auth-cache-logins --rights-type owner_only --storage-filesystem-folder /var/lib/radicale/collections

settings.label: Mailbox authentication
settings.description: Sign in with a full mailbox email address and its password. Radicale checks the account directly with your mail server over IMAPS (port 993), with certificate verification.

fields.label: IMAP hostname
fields.help: Use the hostname shown in Mail → Overview. It must be reachable from this app and have a trusted TLS certificate. Use a separate hostname, such as dav.example.com, for this app's HTTPS address.
fields.patternError: Enter a hostname without a scheme, port, or path.

endpoints.label: Calendars & contacts
endpoints.help: Connect clients over HTTPS using a mailbox email address and password.

connection.title: Connect your calendar and contacts
connection.description: Open the HTTPS address to create a calendar or address book. Add that server to a CalDAV or CardDAV client using your full mailbox email address and mailbox password.

guide.intro: Apple Calendar and Contacts, Thunderbird, Fantastical, and DAVx⁵ can connect to this server. Use HTTPS with port 443; the username is your full email address.
guide.useHint: The server provides /.well-known/caldav and /.well-known/carddav discovery. Manage the app and its persistent volume under Apps. Mailbox password changes apply to subsequent DAV requests.

features.title: Native client sync
features.description: CalDAV calendars and CardDAV contacts with standard discovery endpoints.

features.title: Existing mailbox accounts
features.description: Authenticate directly with your IMAP server over verified TLS.

features.title: Private, persistent collections
features.description: Each mailbox owns its collections, stored in a persistent app volume.
